subject: ARLO SEO — Weekly Pulse — 2026-10-05
html:
Weekly Pulse — Oct 5, 2026

~14 weeks since kickoff (2026-07-04). Fresh live pull, site_id 12704162.

Leads proxy (GA4 conversions)

Pending. GA4 (G-CP22NBPLFP) is firing on the live site, but this sandbox has no outbound access to the GA4 reporting API, so conversions can't be pulled from here. A scheduled data Action (outside this sandbox) fills this number in later — until then, leading indicators below (rank, backlinks, AI visibility) are the only available signal.

All 22 tracked keywords sat at the not-ranked floor (avg position 100) every single day this week (10/1→10/5), Google USA — unchanged since tracking began 2026-08-01, now 14 straight weeks flat.

Traffic vs last week

SE Ranking's domain overview still returns no ranking keywords for askarlo.app in the US index — no organic footprint to measure traffic from yet, unchanged from last week.

Anything broken?

No. All 47 SEO Report Email runs since kickoff are green, 47/47 all-time, zero failures. Backlinks flat at 3 / 2 referring domains, unchanged since 2026-09-10. AI Result Tracker still has zero LLM engines configured — no AI-visibility baseline exists; this needs a human decision in SE Ranking before AI-citation movement can be tracked at all. catalog.ts's 9 gated connectors (all past their own ETAs) are byte-for-byte unchanged. In the destinations catalog, power_bi (July ETA) and excel (August ETA) are now past due and snowflake (September ETA) just joined them — none have flipped status yet. One to watch: shareable_dashboard's ETA is \"October 2026\" — this month — so a status flip there over the next few pulses would open the next real content opportunity.

Reading the week

Another quiet-by-design week: every static audit, the connector matrix, the comparison hub, the destinations comparisons, and the blog are all already re-verified exhausted against current demand, and a fresh 10-term keyword pull this session (looking specifically for anything new since last week) turned up nothing beyond terms already covered by live pages. 14 straight weeks at the not-ranked floor continues to read as a brand-new domain (DA 0) still inside Google's normal indexing/trust ramp rather than a content problem — the underlying keyword thesis hasn't weakened. The two things still worth a human's 30 minutes, unchanged from every recent pulse: (1) GSC sitemap submission, still not done since Week 1 of the original plan; (2) off-page Phase 1, still 0 of 6 free directory listings. Both remain the cheapest, most leveraged open items on the entire plan, and neither can be done from this sandbox.
